audit.why: Content spikes[] correctly key to level-2 Q/E poke-and-root, level-6 Stranglethorns AoE punishing grouped all-ins, first-item Liandry's/Torch plant scaling, and her sustained late-game plant damage.

audit.corrected: Added a Don'ts entry on the grounding denial.
